svg.aria-label: Region of attraction for dx1/dt = −x1 + x2, dx2/dt = −x1 − x2 + x2 cubed. Blue trajectories converge to the origin, pink ones diverge. The quadratic Lyapunov function V = (x1 squared + x2 squared)/2 decreases wherever |x2| < 1, so the disc x1 squared + x2 squared < 1 (green) is a guaranteed, if cautious, estimate of the region of attraction

g.text: shaded band |x₂| < 1: dV/dt < 0 · green circle: the estimate V < 1/2
